title: Elephant Toothpaste
description: Create a massive foam eruption using hydrogen peroxide, yeast, and dish soap. The catalyst reaction releases oxygen rapidly, creating towering foam columns.

title: Non-Newtonian Oobleck
description: Mix cornstarch and water to create a substance that's both solid and liquid. Punch it and it's hard — dip slowly and it flows like water.

title: Rain in a Jar
description: Simulate rainfall in a jar. Layer hot and cold water, then add shaving cream as clouds and food coloring that falls like raindrops.

title: Lava Lamp
description: Make a working lava lamp with oil, water, Alka-Seltzer, and food coloring. The gas bubbles carry colored water up and down in mesmerizing blobs.

title: Static Electricity Butterfly
description: Create a paper butterfly that appears to fly using static electricity. A balloon or PVC pipe makes it dance in mid-air.

title: Crystal Garden
description: Grow colorful crystal formations over several days using silicate solutions and metal salts. Each salt creates a different colored 'plant'.
